headword: {生徒|せいと}{会長|かいちょう}

definitions.explanation: Used primarily for middle and high school. For university, {学生|がくせい}{会長|かいちょう} is used.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{生徒|せいと}{会長|かいちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{選|えら}ばれた→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: She was elected student council president.

examples.japanese: {生徒|せいと}{会長|かいちょう}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{全校|ぜんこう}→全校：28166_zenkou⟧⟦{集会|しゅうかい}→集会：14654_shuukai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦スピーチ→スピーチ：03852_supiichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I gave a speech at the school assembly as student council president.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{生徒|せいと}{会長|かいちょう}⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立候補|りっこうほ}→立候補：13778_rikkouho⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦つもり→つもり：01152_tsumori⟧だ。
examples.english: I plan to run in next month's student council president election.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{生徒|せいと}{会|かい}→生徒会：05378_seitokai⟧ (student council) + {長|ちょう} (head, chief). The leader of the student government at a Japanese middle school (⟦{中学校|ちゅうがっこう}→中学校：01465_chuugakkou⟧) or high school (⟦{高校|こうこう}→高校：01083_koukou⟧). This role is prominent in Japanese school life and frequently appears in anime, manga, and school-themed media.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {生徒|せいと}{会長|かいちょう}⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧: student council president election
- {生徒|せいと}{会長|かいちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立候補|りっこうほ}→立候補：13778_rikkouho⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to run for student council president
- {生徒|せいと}{会長|かいちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧: to serve as student council president

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japanese schools, the ⟦{生徒|せいと}{会|かい}→生徒会：05378_seitokai⟧ (student council) plays a significant role in organizing school events such as the ⟦{文化|ぶんか}{祭|さい}→文化祭：05589_bunkasai⟧ (cultural festival) and ⟦{体育|たいいく}{祭|さい}→体育祭：21233_taiikusai⟧ (sports day). The {生徒|せいと}{会長|かいちょう} is typically elected by popular vote and is seen as a leadership position.
